text: That previous diagnosis is incorrect; Multiple Sclerosis does not cause rapid breathing, liver enlargement, or pitting edema in a 3-year-old. The clinical picture of hepatomegaly, ascites, and pitting edema without respiratory infection strongly suggests a cardiac or hepatic origin. Please check the lab results for Liver Function Tests and Creatinine, and request a Chest X-Ray to rule out Congenital Heart Disease or severe heart failure. DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Heart Disease (specifically Right Heart Failure)
